players.product: Chromium single-cell and Atera spatial biology platforms

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration: no single customer represented more than 10% of revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023. Sales to academic and government institutions represent the largest portion of direct sales revenue; the company expects sales to biopharmaceutical companies to represent a growing proportion of revenue.

FY2025 revenue by source (10-K, in thousands): total revenue $642,823 (up 5%) versus $610,785. Consumables $507,183 (up 3%), of which Single Cell $363,206 (down 2%) and Spatial $143,977 (up 19%); instruments $56,779 (down 39%), of which Spatial $34,108 (down 41%) and Single Cell $22,671 (down 36%); services $32,726 (up 35%); license and royalty revenue $46,135 versus $321. Chromium Universal Gene Expression consumables were the highest-selling consumables products in each of 2025, 2024 and 2023.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue $642,823 thousand (up 5%); Spatial consumables $143,977 thousand (up 19%); instruments $56,779 thousand (down 39%)

quarterly_data.signal: Manufacturing and supply (10-K): the Chromium, Visium CytAssist and Xenium instruments are manufactured by third-party contract manufacturers (instruments mostly assembled and tested by contract manufacturers in Asia and the United States), while 10x performs optical and final assembly, integration and testing of Xenium in-house; many consumables are made at its Pleasanton (California), Singapore and Taiwan facilities, and it expects to manufacture an increasing amount of consumables in-house. It depends on a limited number of suppliers, in some cases sole sources, for enzymes and amplification mixes. As of December 31, 2025 it had commitments to make a total of $12.2 million in purchases over the next two years (contract-manufacturer component purchases and supplier minimum annual purchases), and it anticipated capital expenditures of approximately $15 million to $20 million over the next 12 months, including manufacturing and R&D equipment. The company states that, excluding acquisitions, it does not expect its operating expenditures to meaningfully increase in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: $12.2 million purchase commitments over the next two years; capex approximately $15 million to $20 million over the next 12 months
